create_ExponentialMovingAverage: create an ExponentialMovingAverage instance with a decay value to track debiased exponential moving averages
update_ExponentialMovingAverage: update the ExponentialMovingAverage with a tensor value to compute the running debiased average
get_ExponentialMovingAverage_value: get the current EMA value from an ExponentialMovingAverage instance via its value property
reset_ExponentialMovingAverage: reset an ExponentialMovingAverage instance to zero out its counter, hidden state, and average
initialize_ExponentialMovingAverage: initialize an ExponentialMovingAverage with a tensor to allocate hidden and average variables
